cards.text: King David is running from his own son Absalom (2 Samuel 15:13-14), and he's gone up the Mount of Olives barefoot and weeping (2 Samuel 15:30). Just past the summit, somebody is waiting for him. It's Ziba, the servant of Mephibosheth, Jonathan's son and King Saul's grandson (2 Samuel 9:6, 9).

cards.question: Ziba is standing there waiting for David. What has Ziba brought with him?

answers.text: Saddled donkeys loaded with food and wine
A band of armed men from Benjamin
A message from Hushai in Jerusalem

cards.text: And Ziba did NOT pack light: two hundred loaves of bread, a hundred clusters of raisins, a hundred summer fruits and a skin of wine. Friend, I run a whole bakery with six stations, and even I'd look at that pile and say, 'Okay, SHOW-OFF.'

cards.question: David asks Ziba why he has all this. Ziba says the donkeys are for the king's ___ to ride, and the bread and summer fruit are for the young ___ to eat.

cards.text: Ziba's got it all worked out, even wine to refresh anyone who gets exhausted in the wilderness. Then David asks, 'Where is your master's grandson?'

cards.question: True or false: Ziba says Mephibosheth stayed in Jerusalem because he expects Israel to give him back his grandfather's kingdom.
David makes a decision right there on the road. What does the king give Ziba?

answers.text: A seat at the king's own table

cards.text: Ziba says, 'I humbly bow before you.' Friend, he came up that hill with two donkeys and he's going down with EVERYTHING Mephibosheth owns, and I once sold for a quarter.
As King David comes near Bahurim, a man from the family of Saul's house comes out. His name is Shimei son of Gera, and let me tell you, he did NOT bring donkeys full of bread.

cards.question: What does Shimei son of Gera do as he comes toward David?

answers.text: Bows low and asks for mercy
Warns him that Absalom is coming

cards.text: Shimei keeps throwing stones at David and his servants, even with the troops and mighty men right there on David's right and left, and he yells, 'Get out, get out, you worthless man of bloodshed!' One man taking on a whole army, friend, that's a chihuahua barking at a garbage truck.

cards.question: Shimei says the LORD has paid David back for the blood of the house of ___ and handed the kingdom to David's son ___.

cards.text: Abishai son of Zeruiah, David's nephew (1 Chronicles 2:16), has heard ENOUGH. He says, 'Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king?'

cards.question: Abishai wants to deal with Shimei. What does he ask David to let him do?

answers.text: Go over and cut off his head

cards.question: David answers Abishai, 'What have I to do with you, O sons of Zeruiah?' What reason does David give for leaving Shimei alone?

answers.text: The LORD may have told Shimei to curse him
Shimei is protected by the house of Saul
Killing Shimei would turn the people away

cards.question: True or false: David says his own son seeks his life, so how much more this Benjamite, and he tells his men to leave Shimei alone and let him curse.
With the curses still coming, what does David hope the LORD might do for him?

answers.text: Repay him with good for the cursing
Strike Shimei down right on the spot
Turn Absalom's heart back toward him

cards.text: So they keep walking, and Shimei walks right along the ridge across from them, cursing, throwing stones and flinging dust at David. Friend, I spent YEARS buried in dust in a junk drawer, and even I think that's too much dust.

cards.question: True or false: When David and the people with him finally arrive, they're still full of energy.

cards.text: And there, David refreshes himself. That's where we'll leave it for now, friend, because this story is a LONG way from over.

findings.problem: The fill in the blank asks the baker to complete Ziba's wording. Blank 2 is the phrase 'young ___', and the baker has not seen this wording. Nothing on the earlier cards lets the baker reason out 'men' over 'guards', 'priests' or 'elders'. Only the wording does, and 'young elders' doesn't read naturally, so 'men' stands out. Card 2 already covered what Ziba brought. A better question would ask what the supplies are for, such as for David's people on the road.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

findings.problem: The joke doesn't hold together. The core action is Ziba walking away with a huge reward after a small gift. 'And I once sold for a quarter' is a contrast about Papa Dorin's price, not the same action, so a stranger would say 'huh?' It also depends on the 25-cent bin detail from the backstory, and this lesson never sets that up.

rule.text: The everyday comparison must have the same action.

findings.problem: The question asks, 'What reason does David give for leaving Shimei alone?' That states David's decision as a given and gives away card 16, which asks whether David tells his men to leave Shimei alone and let him curse. Because of this, the key turn of the passage, David holding back Abishai, is never something the baker works out.

rule.text: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

findings.problem: The story-isn't-over line copies the doc's example almost word for word ('That's where we'll leave it for now, friend'). It isn't a new line written for this passage.

rule.text: The examples show the idea. Write your own line each time.
